_comment: Default medication set for med-curves. Edit this file to model your own regimen. Half-lives are in hours. ka and ke are computed at load time as ln(2)/halfLifeAbsH and ln(2)/halfLifeElimH. For bimodal ER drugs, use halfLifeAbs1H/halfLifeElim1H + halfLifeAbs2H/halfLifeElim2H + delay2 (hours) + ratio [first, second]. Optional flags: isBet (creates an acid window), acidSens+acidLoss (degraded by acid), acidBen+acidBoost (boosted by acid), ssFloor (steady-state plateau), accum (weekly accumulation factor).
